nodes.title: Further Education and Training Phase
nodes.description: CAPS FET Phase covering Grades 10 to 12

nodes.title: Grade 11
nodes.description: Grade 11 FET Phase

nodes.title: Business Studies Grade 11
nodes.description: CAPS Business Studies for Grade 11

nodes.title: Influences On, and Control Factors Relating to the Business Environments
nodes.description: Ways to be involved in business environments if beneficial to the business; recap components of micro, market and macro business environments; examination of control factors (more control over micro, less over market, no control over macro).

nodes.title: Micro and Market Environment Components
nodes.description: Micro environment: vision, mission statement, goals and objectives, organisational resources, management and leadership, eight functions and activities. Market environment: consumers/customers, suppliers, intermediaries, competitors, other organisations/civil society (CBOs, NGOs, regulators, strategic allies, unions).

nodes.title: Macro Environment and Control Factors
nodes.description: Macro environment: physical/natural, economic, social/cultural/demographic, technological, legal and political, international/global, institutional environments. Examination of control factors: more control over micro, less control over market, no control over macro environment.

nodes.title: Challenges of the Business Environments
nodes.description: Challenges of the micro (internal), market and macro business environments.

nodes.title: Adapting to Challenges of Business Environments
nodes.description: How a business constantly needs to adapt to challenges of the micro, market and macro business environments; information management, strategic responses, mergers, takeovers, acquisitions and alliances, organisation design and flexibility, direct influence and social responsibility; lobbying, networking and power relations.

nodes.title: Strategic Responses and Adaptation
nodes.description: Ways in which a business can adapt to challenges of the business environment: information management, strategic responses, mergers, takeovers, acquisitions and alliances, organisation design and flexibility, direct influence of the environment and social responsibility.

nodes.title: Lobbying, Networking and Power Relations
nodes.description: Lobbying (e.g. hedging against inflation, bargaining sessions between management and unions, influencing supervisory body/regulators); networking (e.g. finding new customers); power relationships (e.g. strategic alliance agreements, persuasion of large investors, company representatives' influence).

nodes.title: Impact and Challenges of Contemporary Socio-Economic Issues on Business Operations
nodes.description: Impact of contemporary socio-economic issues on business operations and productivity; intellectual property rights; industrial relations developments; Labour Relations Act; trade unions.

nodes.title: Socio-Economic Issues and Business Operations
nodes.description: Impact of contemporary socio-economic issues on business operations and productivity: income, inflation, social/cultural/demographic issues, economic crime, population growth, illiteracy, lack of skills, unavailability of natural resources, inefficiency in use of resources, dumping, exhaustion of natural resources, piracy, strikes.

nodes.title: Intellectual Property Rights and Labour Relations
nodes.description: Business solutions to deal with piracy; nature and definition of intellectual property rights (copyright, patent, trademark); developments in industrial relations (labour strikes, go-slows, lockouts); Labour Relations Act (nature and purpose); trade unions (definition, history, roles and functions).

nodes.title: Business Sectors
nodes.description: Links between various primary, secondary, and tertiary enterprises; examination of the links between primary, secondary and tertiary sectors.

nodes.title: Benefits of a Company Versus Other Forms of Ownership
nodes.description: Benefits and challenges of establishing a company versus other forms of ownership (including taxation issues); recap characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of forms of ownership; formation of companies; Memorandum of Incorporation; name, incorporation and commencement of the company; prospectus.

nodes.title: Company vs Other Forms of Ownership
nodes.description: Benefits and challenges of establishing a company versus other forms of ownership (including taxation issues); recap characteristics, advantages and disadvantages; benefits and challenges of a company versus sole trader, partnership, co-operatives.

nodes.title: Formation of Companies
nodes.description: Formation of companies; the company's charter – Memorandum of Incorporation; name of the company, incorporation and commencement of the company; prospectus.

nodes.title: Avenues of Acquiring Business
nodes.description: Avenues of acquiring businesses (franchising, outsourcing, leasing); advantages and disadvantages; contractual implications (royalties, legalities).

nodes.title: Creative Thinking and Problem Solving, Stress, Crisis and Change Management
nodes.description: Application of creative thinking to address business problems and improve practice; routine vs creative thinking; mental blocks; problem-solving skills; Delphi technique and force-field analysis; working with others; stress management; crisis and change management.

nodes.title: Creative Thinking and Problem Solving
nodes.description: Application of creative thinking to address business problems and to improve business practice; routine vs creative thinking; mental blocks to creativity and idea generation; problem-solving skills in a business context; more complex problem-solving techniques (Delphi technique and force-field analysis revision); working with others to solve problems; creative solutions to business problems assessed against the reality of the business environment.

nodes.title: Stress, Crisis and Change Management
nodes.description: Concepts relating to stress, crisis and change management; how to manage stress; importance of stress management in pressurised work environments; crisis and change management; dealing with business-related crises (tight deadlines, loss of property, illness); dealing with and adapting to change (unemployment, retrenchment, globalisation, affirmative action).

nodes.title: Marketing Function
nodes.description: Marketing activities; product policy; pricing policy; distribution policy; marketing communication (sales promotion, advertising, publicity, personal selling).

nodes.title: Marketing Activities and Marketing Mix
nodes.description: Marketing activities (locating the consumer, standardisation and grading, storage, transport, financing, risk-bearing, buying and selling); marketing mix – product policy (product development, design, packaging and trademarks); pricing policy (importance, techniques, determination, influencing factors, price adjustments).

nodes.title: Distribution and Communication Policy
nodes.description: Distribution policy: channels of distribution, intermediaries, direct and indirect distribution; communication policy: sales promotion, advertising, publicity and personal selling.

nodes.title: Production Function
nodes.description: Production planning and control; safety management; quality control including quality management systems (SABS), quality control bodies and policies.

nodes.title: Production Planning and Control
nodes.description: Production planning (information about production planning and control); production planning: planning, routing, scheduling and loading; production control: dispatching, following up, inspection and corrective action.

nodes.title: Safety Management and Quality Control
nodes.description: Safety management: knowledge about factory safety, machinery and Occupational Health and Safety Act; quality control: quality management systems (SABS), quality control bodies and policies.

nodes.title: Professionalism and Ethics
nodes.description: Theories and principles of professionalism and ethics; application of principles and skills of professional, responsible, ethical and effective business practice; concept of ethics and different perspectives on ethics; ethical business ventures.

nodes.title: Assessment of Entrepreneurial Qualities in Business
nodes.description: Degree to which a business embraces entrepreneurial qualities; identification and assessment of a business against entrepreneurial qualities (risk taking, perseverance, good management, etc.); critical reflections on a business venture; exploration of what makes a business successful; key success factors.

nodes.title: Transform a Business Plan Into an Action Plan
nodes.description: Transformation of a business plan into an action plan (including Gantt charts and timelines) collaboratively or independently; planning tools: Gantt charts or work breakdown structure (WBS) with timelines and responsibilities; project planning.

nodes.title: Start a Business Venture Based on an Action Plan
nodes.description: Collaboratively or independently starting a business venture based on an action plan; initiating and setting up business ventures to generate income; acquiring funding (equity capital/loans/debt, considering other sources of funding/capital).

nodes.title: Presentation of Business Information
nodes.description: Accurate and concise verbal and non-verbal presentation of business-related information; presentation and validation of business-related information in verbal and non-verbal format (tables, graphs, diagrams, illustrations, posters and hand-outs); written information – reports, business plans, business information and analysis; responding professionally to questions.

nodes.title: Verbal and Non-Verbal Presentations
nodes.description: Accurate and concise verbal and non-verbal presentation of a variety of business-related information (including graphs); presentation and validation (support) of business-related information in verbal and non-verbal format (tables, graphs, diagrams, illustrations, posters and hand-outs).

nodes.title: Written Information and Responding to Questions
nodes.description: Design and layout of the presentation using different visual aids (slides, posters and hand-outs); written information: reports, business plans, business information and analysis, steps in report-writing, composing a flyer; responding in a non-aggressive and professional manner to questions about work and presentations.

nodes.title: Team Stages and Dynamics, Theories and Conflict Management
nodes.description: Stages of team development/building a team; conflict management definition, causes, skills and techniques to resolve differences.

nodes.title: Stages of Team Development
nodes.description: Stages of team development: forming stage (getting to know each other), storming stage (true character starts to show/first round conflict), norming stage (settling and reconciliation), performing stage (working as a team towards the goal).

nodes.title: Conflict Management
nodes.description: Definition of conflict; causes of conflict in the business; definition of conflict management; conflict management skills to resolve differences in business situations.

nodes.title: Introduction to Human Resources Function
nodes.description: Human resources activities (recruitment and selection, contracts, induction, salaries, and other benefits); procedures related to recruitment, selection and interviewing; legalities of employment contracts; procedures of induction and placements; salary determination (piecemeal and time-related) including personal tax; employee benefits (pension, medical, other).

nodes.title: Recruitment, Selection, Contracts and Induction
nodes.description: Human resources activities: recruitment and selection, contracts, induction, salaries, and other benefits; procedures related to recruitment, selection and interviewing; legalities of employment contracts; procedures of induction and placements.

nodes.title: Salary Determination and Employee Benefits
nodes.description: Interviewing, selection and induction; salary determination (piecemeal and time-related), including personal tax, link to basic conditions of employment; employee benefits: pension, medical, other.
